views.question: Will NVIDIA commence production shipments of its Vera Rubin platform by December 31, 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences production shipments of Vera Rubin on or before 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA does not commence production shipments of Vera Rubin on or before 2026-12-31.

views.looks_at: First SK Telecom AI factory deployment
views.question: Will the first SK Telecom AI factory using NVIDIA DSX and Vera Rubin come online by December 31, 2027?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: The first such AI factory is operational by 2027-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: The first such AI factory is not operational by 2027-12-31.
